critical_code_review_comments: pytest-xdist parallel workers race with the single-session-kick rule (SESSION_KICKED). New test file works when run with -o addopts='' (serial). If a future agent runs the full suite in parallel, they must disable xdist or scope logins per worker. Non-blocking, but noted.
PUT /api/settings/workspace-mode returns 401 for unauth (via require_current_user dep) which the spec called out as 401 — matches.
AdminUpdateUserRequest.company_name = '' correctly triggers $unset (server.py L571-577), preserving contract that non-string None leaves the field untouched.
Frontend badge text is truncated to 'TEST_A…' (ellipsis) on narrow rows — expected behavior per current CSS. Full name available in tooltip if implemented; acceptable.

In personal mode with ahmet, [data-testid=task-assignee-input] and [data-testid=task-company-input] are guarded by isTeamView — spec says 'DOM'da OLABİLİR ama is_visible=False'. Not directly verified in the E2E run (task form wasn't opened in personal mode) but backend contract + code review confirm the guard. Recommend adding a follow-up unit/render test in the frontend if the guard changes.
Admin bypass: isTeamView = role==='admin' || workspaceMode==='team' — admin serkan sees company UI in KULLANICILAR tab regardless of workspace_mode. Confirmed via UI test.
